title: Modernize frmSplash
problem_statement: The frmSplash form uses outdated VB6 patterns that are not compatible with modern C# applications.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential UI/UX degradation and maintainability issues.
suggested_approach: Rewrite the frmSplash form using modern C# WinForms or WPF.
success_criteria: frmSplash is fully functional in C# with equivalent behavior.
